prepared_for: Sarah Haywood and the events team
title: Celebrations, *on Egyptian ground.*
subtitle: Three settings for an Egypt wedding or celebration produced by Sarah Haywood, with NOYA running the ground: venues, permits, stays and every guest.

blocks.text: When a client asks for Egypt, Sarah Haywood keeps the couple, the design and the production. NOYA runs the ground: venues and permits through our local partners, room blocks, guest arrivals and a guest desk for the whole stay.

items.title: A welcome evening at Giza
items.text: The weekend opens with dinner facing the Pyramids at sunset, for every guest.

items.title: A celebration on the Nile
items.text: A smaller celebration between Luxor and Aswan: riverside hotels, a Nile journey and private guided visits.
meta: Hotels, river journey, guiding, guest movement

items.title: A weekend on the Red Sea
items.text: El Gouna for the full weekend: a ceremony by the sea, the celebration and a farewell lunch, with guests in one resort.
meta: Room blocks, beach venue, transfers, guest desk

rows: The opening of the Grand Egyptian Museum has given Cairo a new cultural landmark.
El Gouna is a year-round Red Sea resort town of marinas, luxury hotels and residences, with destination weddings among its strengths.
